title: Approver Seat Relief on Paloma Business Extra Seat Charges
content:
On a Paloma Business account, approver seats are freed from an extra seat charge by the payouts a second user approved in the three months before the day the charge is worked out, counted from the day after the same calendar day three months earlier up to and including that day. A payout counts when it has an approval record dated in that window.

### Relief clause

10 or more approvals free 2 of the users charged; 1 to 9 approvals free 1 of them; no approval frees none; the users charged never go below zero.

### Questions answered

**What is counted?** Payouts approved by a second user with the approver role, by the date of the approval, inside the three-month window.

**An account has 2 users charged and 12 approvals in the window. How many users are charged after the relief?** 2 users are freed, leaving 0.

**An account has 1 user charged and 12 approvals.** Freeing 2 would go below zero; the users charged are 0.

**An account has 3 users charged and 4 approvals.** 1 is freed, leaving 2.

**Which approvals count for a charge worked out on 20 May?** Those dated from 21 February through 20 May.

### Ladder

| Approvals in the three-month window | Users freed |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 2 |
| 1 to 9 | 1 |
| None | 0 |
